title: Starship Flight 15 reaches orbit, but booster explodes and planned double catch is aborted
detail: DW reports Starship Flight 15 reached orbit, but the Super Heavy booster exploded and the planned first-ever double catch of booster and ship was aborted.

media.caption: Starship Flight 15 launch; booster recovery failed

title: Starship upper stage caught by launch tower arms after nearly a day in orbit
detail: Ship 42 was caught by the Mechazilla tower arms at Starbase roughly 22.5 hours after the Nov 13 liftoff, after 14 orbits and deployment of 26 Starlink V3 satellites. The booster, meanwhile, missed its tower catch after an early-ending return burn and exploded over the Gulf of Mexico.
